query: UPDATE central.step_attempts SET version = $6, invocation_id = $7, invocation_generation = CASE WHEN $7::uuid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $8::bigint END, state = $9, outcome = COALESCE($10::jsonb, outcome), context = COALESCE($11::jsonb, context), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND task_id = $2 AND run_id = $3 AND step_id = $4 AND id = $5 AND version = $12
